{{Quote|Jal, get over to that clearing and figure out a retrieval plan. Take Henle and the new kid with you. Move!|[[Team Razor]] commanding officer|<ref name="HS" />}}
'''Henle''' was a [[Pathfinders/Legends|Pathfinder]] serving in the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. Henle was assigned to [[Team Razor]], and was part of the team that established [[Outpost Cinder]]. The commanding [[Major/Legends|Major]] ordered [[Jal]] to take Henle and another trooper to establish a retrieval plan.<ref name="HS" />
